desc: The Midwest Industries Alpha Series M-LOK Handguards brings the AK platform into the 21st century. Machined from 6061 aluminum and given a durable hard coat anodized finish. Developed for full flexibility, allowing multiple configurations such as full handguard, bottom handguard only, Alpha series optic and top cover accessories, and railed gas tubes. Extremely adjustable design giving the user the ability to ensure Alpha fits on most AKM firearms with stamped receivers.
